The '''Koros sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of [[Realspace/Legends|realspace]] that was located within the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]]. It contained the [[Empress Teta system/Legends|Empress Teta system]].<ref name="NoP" />
